depiction.primary_object: front view of a passenger car with round headlights
depiction.composition: single object in front view with a checkmark floating above it

readings.meaning: car inspection, safety check, or emissions test
car rental confirmation, ride booking, or vehicle readiness

ambiguity: May overlap with a plain car icon for general driving tasks if the checkmark is overlooked.

modifier_semantics.meaning: inspected, verified, confirmed, approved, or ready

task_intents: get car safety or emissions inspection
confirm rental car booking for trip
do pre-trip check on the car

example_tasks.task: Take the Subaru to the state inspection station before the sticker expires
Have our mechanic inspect the used Mazda3 before making an offer
Double-check the Alamo reservation includes an additional driver for Crete
Run through the winter readiness checklist on the Volvo before December
Verify the VIN on the title matches the car door jamb
Print the certificate for the glovebox
Walk around and photograph any existing bumper scratches
Check tire pressure, oil level, and coolant before driving up to Tahoe on Friday
Get the post-repair safety inspection signed off so the insurer releases the claim check
Confirm with the dealership that the recall check on the airbag sensor is complete
Go over the 2018 Golf with a paint depth gauge and OBD scanner

example_tasks_es: Pedir cita para la ITV del Seat antes de que caduque en mayo
Confirmar la reserva del coche de alquiler en el aeropuerto de Santiago
Revisar niveles de aceite, líquido de frenos y presión de ruedas antes del viaje
example_tasks_ru: Пройти техосмотр и оформить диагностическую карту до конца месяца
Подтвердить бронь аренды машины в Тбилиси на майские
Загнать выбранную Camry на подъёмник для проверки перед покупкой

context_tasks.task: Pay the $45 state emissions fee online
Put the new registration sticker on the license plate
Call Dave's Garage to ask if they do state inspections on Saturdays
File the MOT pass certificate in the car folder

near_misses.task: Wash and vacuum the car before Sunday
near_misses.better: car wash or plain car icon

near_misses.task: Check train times to Manchester for the dealership visit
Buy a certified pre-owned baby car seat
Replace the cracked windshield wiper blades
Renew driver's license at the DMV
Check how much is left on the auto loan

reasoning: Shows a front-facing car with a checkmark above it, clearly signaling vehicle inspection (MOT, smog check, pre-purchase check), car readiness, or a confirmed rental/ride booking. It is more specific than a plain car or repair wrench icon, fitting verification and inspection tasks best.
